name: alegauss
description: Every Claude Code plugin published from Alexandre Oliveira's repositories, in one catalogue.

plugins.name: roadkeep
plugins.description: Refuses the hand-edit of a governed roadmap, changelog or rationale file and names the command to call instead, runs the gate as the turn ends, and offers add, ship, pick and lint as MCP tools and slash commands.

plugins.name: winwright
plugins.description: Drives a Windows desktop application through UI Automation and reports what it observed: a check that could not run is a third verdict instead of a green.

plugins.name: polyweave
plugins.description: Make a game's parts by declaring what each must satisfy: 3D assets, pictures, sound loops and the world's text, searched and checked on Blender, Godot and paid generators.

plugins.name: piano
plugins.description: A piano Claude Code can write scores for, play and teach from: validate and keep scores, drive the Piano app, and practise a passage at a climbing tempo.
